description: Daily MVRV ratio (market cap / realized cap) for BTC or ETH from CoinMetrics' free community data, with the latest value, the window mean and standard deviation, and its z-score. Labels are plain statistics (HIGH_Z, LOW_Z, MID), not buy or sell calls. Realized cap in USD is not in the free tier, so only the ratio is returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
